title: Does CoT Monitoring Generalize to Non-Coding Task Domains?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if CoT monitoring advantage is domain-specific, safety teams need per-domain strategies. This directly informs whether CoT monitoring is a general or narrow solution, with immediate deployment implications.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running a reasoning model on GPQA/AIME tasks and building a CoT vs. action-only monitor comparison. DeepSeek-R1-8B is open-source and runnable on medium compute. The monitor comparison pipeline requires some setup but uses standard LM prompting.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two task domains (science, math) with CoT vs. action-only comparison. Clear metric (AUROC difference). Could be tight within 30 hours if limited to one model and two domains, but setting up the monitoring pipeline takes time.
